scenes.summary: Artie looks at his stats and sees his HP is now 'NaN' (Not a Number).
scenes.transition_in_text: The status screen flickers with red error messages, the 'HP' bar replaced by a string of nonsensical characters.

sections.title: The Aftermath of the Crash

chapters.stakes_shift: The survival of the entire game world is threatened as Artie's crits start breaking the source code.
chapters.title: The Final Roll

bridge.to_next: Book 2: The Quest for the Source Code.

chapters.goal: Set up the long-term quest to fix (or further break) the world.

sections.end_condition: Artie realizes his immortality is just as annoying as his 1 HP build.
sections.intent: Establish the new status quo for Artie and Fizz.

scenes.outcome: Artie adapts to his new existence.
scenes.summary: Artie learns how to eat 'Data-Packets' instead of food.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie reaches out to touch a floating cube of light.
scenes.transition_out_text: Fizz points toward a distant, glowing tower on the horizon.

scenes.outcome: The long-term goal is established.
scenes.summary: Fizz explains that the only way to save the world is to reach the 'Server Room' at the center of the world.
scenes.transition_in_text: Fizz's voice is solemn as she explains their new mission.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie stands at the edge of a wireframe cliff, testing his new body.

scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie realizes his immortality is just as annoying as his 1 HP build.
scenes.outcome: Artie realizes his immortality is just as annoying as his 1 HP build.
scenes.summary: Artie tests his 'NaN' HP by jumping off a cliff; he doesn't die, he just clips through the floor and ends up back at the top.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie takes a deep breath and steps off the edge.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie's descent is a blur of unrendered air until he snaps back to the ledge, his boots clicking against the wireframe stone.

sections.title: The New Normal

sections.end_condition: The series arc is locked in with the quest 'Delete the Admin'.
sections.intent: Introduce the faction that will help Artie in the future.

scenes.outcome: Artie finds allies who know the world's secrets.
scenes.summary: A group of 'Beta-Testers' led by a veteran survivor finds Artie in the Null-Zone.
scenes.transition_in_text: The figures approach cautiously, their weapons lowered as they emerge from the flickering static of the lower valley.
scenes.transition_out_text: The lead tester pulls up a holographic map of the world, the blue light illuminating the grim faces of the camp.

scenes.outcome: The rivalry continues with higher stakes.
scenes.summary: The Beta-Testers reveal that Vane is still alive and has been 'upgraded' by the System to be a 'Patch-Hunter'.
scenes.transition_in_text: The holographic map flickers, showing a red icon moving toward them with predatory intent.
scenes.transition_out_text: A legendary quest notification appears in Artie's vision, the text burning with a golden intensity.

scenes.end_condition_echo: The series arc is locked in with the quest 'Delete the Admin'.
scenes.outcome: The series arc is locked in.
scenes.summary: Artie receives his first 'Legendary' quest: 'Delete the Admin'.
scenes.transition_in_text: The golden banner of the quest fills the camp with light, drowning out the dim glow of the static fire.
scenes.transition_out_text: The Beta-Testers activate a swirling vortex of code, the portal's edges fraying into the surrounding trees.

sections.title: The Resistance

sections.end_condition: Artie steps into a portal, ending Book 1.
sections.intent: End on a high note of action and anticipation.

scenes.outcome: The journey begins anew.
scenes.summary: Artie and his new allies prepare to leave the Null-Zone and head to the 'Glitch-Woods'.
scenes.transition_in_text: The portal hums with a power that Artie can feel vibrating through his NaN HP bar as they approach the gate.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie takes a final look at the wireframe world, his hand hovering over the swirling event horizon.

scenes.end_condition_echo: Artie steps into a portal, ending Book 1.
scenes.outcome: End of Book 1.
scenes.summary: Artie looks at the sky and says, 'I hope the next world has better drop rates,' before stepping into a portal.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie's foot touches the edge of the swirling vortex, the code beginning to pull him in.
